rule: Each call in a multi-line method chain is reported on the line of its own method name, not the chain's first line. Call on a receiver of **unknown type**: `recv.member`, using the LAST receiver segment (`self.client.get()` → `client.get`; `a.b.c()` → `b.c`). Call on a **computed receiver** (call result, index, literal, `super` when the superclass is not in the scan): `.member` — a leading dot means "receiver unknown".
notes: Each chain link is reported on its own method-name line (4, 5, 6; `.rows` on 12), not on the line where the chain starts. Bare `compile(...)` is a member of the enclosing class -> `Query#compile`, high.
